title: lane run preflight names the remedy when origin is unreachable
body: Found by scripts/first-day-walkthrough.ts. `krn lane run --task ID` in a repo without origin fails "preflight: origin unreachable with the lane credentials (git ls-remote: fatal: 'origin' does not appear to be a git repository); no session started" and names no remedy; add "add the GitHub remote (git remote add origin URL) and push the default branch, or check the lane credentials". Regression test on the preflight; add the probe to the walkthrough. Outside this lane's scope (src/cli/lane-run/*).
